# DrHelix 1.0.7 (build 14)
- Preserve existing public configuration when enabling Commerce routing. - Fix Source Bus site configuration saves, published-status checks, and unpreview actions. - Exclude access tokens and API keys from cloned sites. - Correct Admin API key deletion, requireAuth values, site-version restores, whole-branch code sync, and reindex job URLs. - Fix authentication for additional Commerce product pages and update available service-token permissions.
This is the macOS direct-download release. The new iPhone and iPad target is distributed separately through TestFlight.
This is an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.6 (build 13)
- Replace the Sidekick API Upgrade checkbox with an Additional Properties key/value section. - Add, edit, or remove top-level JSON settings such as apiUpgrade, preserving existing property values and types. - Support booleans, numbers, quoted strings, null, arrays, and objects without adding apiUpgrade automatically. - Validate property names and JSON values before saving, preventing duplicate keys and conflicts with dedicated controls.
This is an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.6 (build 12)
- Edit text-based Source Bus files in a built-in editor, with explicit saves and checks for conflicting changes. - Open documents in DA Canvas on double-click, or use the macOS default application without an application picker. - Inspect file response headers directly from the File Browser. - Create folders and delete folders with confirmation, refreshing the listing after success. - Configure Sidekick API Upgrade with a checkbox: checked for new configurations, unchecked when absent from existing configurations, and preserving explicit saved values.
Saving source does not automatically preview or publish content.
This is an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.5 (build 11)
- Check for updates immediately after accepting the preview agreement, rather than waiting for the next scheduled check. - Keep scheduled update checks and the manual Check For Updates action, and respect disabled automatic checks.
This is an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.5 (build 10)
- Browse Source Bus files and version history, and open documents in their default macOS application or a chosen editor. - Enable the file browser for markup sites backed by the site's Source Bus URL. - Simplify content-source settings and warn before changing source types without migrating content. - Add site metadata management and improve snapshot error handling. - Update the About window acknowledgments.
This is an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.4 (9)
- Manage snapshots: create, inspect manifests, publish, and delete snapshots. - Manage snapshot schedules with local publish times, snapshot verification warnings, and confirmed schedule deletion. - Enable Scheduler with registration, validation, and publish-role Admin API key creation. - Manage Admin API keys with creation, role selection, local creation/expiration dates, and confirmed revocation. - Standardize text-entry fields and show a friendly message when robots.txt is not configured.
This is an early-preview app. Review changes carefully before publishing snapshots or deleting keys and schedules.

# DrHelix 1.0.3 (build 8)
## What's new
- Direct-download builds now start Sparkle after accepting the preview agreement on each launch. - Automatic update checking is enabled by default. Checks run when due, normally once per day while DrHelix is running, and respect existing user preferences. - Automatic installation is not enabled by this change. Check For Updates remains available for an immediate manual check. - Automatic updater startup failures are reported in the status bar without interrupting the workspace; a manual check can retry startup.
Internal TestFlight builds remain separate and continue receiving updates through TestFlight.
## Requirements
macOS 26.5 or later. Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
This remains an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.2 (build 7)
## What's new
- Manage Access brings Admin, Site, Preview, and Live access configuration into one screen, replacing Enable Site Auth. - Admin authentication supports Auto, Required, and Not required, with editable roles and confirmed configuration deletion. - Site, Preview, and Live each have independent allow-pattern and secret-ID controls, Save, and confirmed Delete actions. - Pick existing site secrets or create a new secret, copy its one-time value somewhere safe, and add its ID to the selected section before explicitly saving access changes. - Read Site now offers an Aggregated checkbox and a native JSON viewer with collapsible objects and arrays, colored values, and a Tree/Raw switch. Raw is the default. - Share supported configuration views by copying their org/site deep link from the toolbar. - Manage Site supports the sourcebus content source type, validates its URL, and restores the previous URL when switching away.
## Requirements
macOS 26.5 or later. Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
This remains an early-preview app. Use care with production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.2 - Build 6
- Open site configuration from webpages using `drhelix://site/{org}/{site}/{screen}` links. - Incoming links reuse the main workspace and select the requested organization, site, and configuration screen. - Known org/site pairs open without a save prompt. New pairs can be saved to local configuration or opened transiently without changing saved organizations, sites, or the last-used selection. - The preview agreement remains required once per app session. Links do not repeat an already-accepted agreement. - Restored the compact, centered agreement window and independent workspace size and position persistence.
Supported link screens: `config`, `headers`, `folders`, `users`, `access-tokens`, `robots`, `sidekick`, `indexes`, `sitemaps`, and `status`.
Links navigate only; they never automatically save, create, or delete server data.
Requires macOS 26.5 or later on an Apple Silicon or 64-bit Intel Mac.
DrHelix remains an early-preview app. Test against non-production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.2 - Build 5
- New HTTP console: choose View > Console or press Command+Shift+Y to show a resizable console beneath the right-hand workspace. - Inspect API request methods, URLs, response statuses, timing, and clickable request and response payloads. - Keep the latest 500 requests in memory, even while the console is hidden. Authentication payloads are omitted and known credentials are redacted; each body is limited to 1 MiB. - Includes the branded drag-to-install DMG and automatic updates through Sparkle.
Requires macOS 26.5 or later on an Apple Silicon or 64-bit Intel Mac.
DrHelix remains an early-preview app. Test against non-production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.1
- Manage Folders now treats missing configuration as an empty state and lets you add the first folder mapping. Blank and duplicate folder paths are rejected, and load/save failures are shown without silently dropping new mappings. - Choose the Git ref used by Code Sync instead of always syncing `main`. - Added TelemetryDeck session and sidebar feature analytics. Analytics are enabled by default after preview agreement acceptance; turn off **Settings > Privacy > Share usage analytics** to stop new collection. Organization/site names, emails, credentials, token values, and request/response data are not sent. - Added a public app privacy policy linked from Settings: https://cloudadoption.github.io/dr-helix/privacy.html.
Includes a signed/notarized drag-to-Applications DMG for installation and a signed ZIP for Sparkle updates. Requires macOS 26.5 or later.
This is an early-preview app. Test against non-production systems.

# DrHelix 1.0.0
- Direct-download installation with a drag-to-Applications DMG. - Automatic updates for direct-download installations through Sparkle. - Site access token listing, creation, copying, and confirmed deletion.
This is an early-preview app. Test against non-production systems.
